messages.subject: Batting durability
messages.text:
Hi there, I'm super excited to find your products (saw them first on an old Across the Fence vid)! Do you have any information on how well milkweed batting retains loft after repeated washing, or if it can be machine washed?
 Thanks!
 Beck

messages.subject: Re: Batting durability
messages.text:
Hi Rebecca,

Really sorry for how long this took, that's not the kind of service we want to offer, and I understand if the wait was frustrating.

To answer your question: our milkweed batting holds up well to repeated washing. The hollow fiber structure is what gives it its insulating power, and that structure doesn't rely on loft the same way down does, so even after compression in the wash, it bounces back nicely. We recommend machine washing cold on a delicate cycle with a gentle soap, and air drying flat. That's the combination that keeps it performing longest.

Glad you found us through Across the Fence, hope you enjoy the products!

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
